# Configuración — qué necesita Faro y qué deja de funcionar sin ello

Este documento se genera desde `backend/service_config/registry.py`, que
es la única fuente de verdad. Si una variable no está aquí, no existe.

## Las dos capas

1. **El entorno** (`backend/.env` o variables reales). Es el piso: la base
   de datos, la llave de firma y el modo de despliegue solo se leen de ahí.
2. **El panel `/instalacion`**, que guarda lo demás cifrado en la base y
   toma efecto sin reiniciar. **La base gana sobre el entorno**, y el panel
   dice cuál está mandando para cada campo.

Quién puede abrir ese panel no es el rol `admin` —que existe dentro de cada
tenant— sino las direcciones listadas en `INSTANCE_ADMIN_EMAILS`. Con esa
variable vacía nadie edita la configuración de la instancia desde la app, y
el panel lo dice nombrando la variable. Un tenant sí puede configurar sus
propios canales (su remitente de correo y su número de WhatsApp).

## Regla que cumple todo lo opcional

Sin su credencial, un servicio **se apaga y lo dice**. No hay 500, no hay
pantalla en blanco y no hay respuesta inventada por otro proveedor: la
función informa que está fuera de servicio y el resto de la aplicación
sigue funcionando.

## `core` — Process identity, database and signing key.

*Tipo:* núcleo. *Editable desde el panel:* no. *Por tenant:* no. *Prueba de conexión:* no.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** Nothing starts. These are read once at boot.

**Mínimo para que encienda:** `SECRET_KEY`, `DATABASE_URL`, `FRONTEND_URL`

Environment only, on purpose: these are read at import time by the connection pool and the JWT signer, so a value written from the panel would not take effect until a restart — and a wrong one would prevent the restart from succeeding.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SECRET_KEY` | — | requerida, secreta, solo entorno | Signs every access and refresh token. Changing it logs everyone out immediately. Use a long random string, never a guessable one. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | — | requerida, secreta, solo entorno | PostgreSQL connection string. The job queue IS a table in this database, so the worker and the API must point at the same one. |
| `FRONTEND_URL` | — | requerida, solo entorno | Public base URL of the web app. Every link the backend emails (verification, password reset, invitation) is built from it, so a wrong value sends working mail to a dead address. |
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | `http://localhost:3000, http://localhost:4000, http://localhost:5000` | solo entorno | CORS origins allowed to call the API from a browser. The frontend's own origin must be in the list or every call fails in the browser while working perfectly from curl. |
| `INSTANCE_ADMIN_EMAILS` | — | solo entorno | Comma-separated addresses allowed to see and edit this instance's service configuration. `admin` is a role inside a tenant, so it cannot grant deployment-wide access. Empty means nobody edits it from the app — the panel becomes read-only for a tenant's own channels and says why. |
| `ENVIRONMENT` | `development` | solo entorno | development / staging / production. In production the server REFUSES to boot with TESTING_MODE=true. |
| `APP_NAME` | `ForecastPlatform` | solo entorno | Product name in email subjects and the API's OpenAPI title. |
| `APP_VERSION` | `1.0.0` | solo entorno | Version string reported by /health and the OpenAPI document. |
| `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES` | `15` | solo entorno | Access-token lifetime. The frontend refreshes silently, so this is a security window, not a UX one. |
| `ALGORITHM` | `HS256` | solo entorno | JWT signing algorithm. Leave it at HS256 unless you are also changing the key material. |
| `STORAGE_PATH` | `backend/storage` | solo entorno | Directory holding uploaded datasets, model artifacts and documents. Postgres holds the metadata; these are the bytes. It is NOT in the database backup — back it up separately. |
| `TESTING_MODE` | `false` | solo entorno | Bypasses ALL quotas, rate limits and upload caps. For load and functional testing only. The server refuses to boot with this on when ENVIRONMENT=production. |

## `llm` — DeepSeek — the only LLM backend. Powers every AI feature.

*Tipo:* servicio externo. *Editable desde el panel:* sí. *Por tenant:* no. *Prueba de conexión:* sí.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** The assistant stops answering, the morning narrative and the inventory insight fall back to their rule-based text, the RAG analyst goes off, and the data-quality diagnosis reports only its deterministic checks. Nothing errors: each surface says the assistant is unavailable.

**Mínimo para que encienda:** `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`

There is exactly one provider and no fallback chain. A previous version picked whichever key happened to be set, which meant a typo in the variable name produced working AI features answered by a different vendor — visible only on the invoice.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | — | requerida, secreta | DeepSeek API key. Without it every AI feature reports itself unavailable instead of answering from somewhere else. |
| `DEEPSEEK_MODEL` | `deepseek-chat` | — | 'deepseek-chat' is the cheap general model. 'deepseek-reasoner' costs more and returns its reasoning separately. |
| `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | — | API base. Point it at a compatible gateway to route through your own proxy — the wire format is OpenAI-shaped. |

Desde el panel se pueden escribir: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `DEEPSEEK_MODEL`, `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL`.

## `email` — Transactional email — Resend first, SMTP as the fallback.

*Tipo:* servicio externo. *Editable desde el panel:* sí. *Por tenant:* sí. *Prueba de conexión:* sí.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** No email leaves: account verification, password reset, invitations, the daily inventory digest, the monthly ROI recap and purchase orders sent to suppliers. Each send is logged and reported as not delivered — the app never claims it mailed something it did not.

**Basta con una de estas:** `RESEND_API_KEY` **o bien** `SMTP_USER` + `SMTP_PASS`

Resend wins when its key is present; SMTP is used otherwise. With neither, `_transport_send` RAISES rather than returning quietly: a silent no-op here made callers report invitations as sent that nobody ever received.

A tenant override applies ONLY to mail addressed to that tenant's own people and its suppliers. Account-lifecycle mail — verification, password reset, invitations — always uses the instance transport, because a tenant must not be able to send the message that grants access to an account.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RESEND_API_KEY` | — | secreta | Resend API key. When set, Resend is the transport and SMTP is not consulted. |
| `EMAIL_FROM` | `Faro <onboarding@resend.dev>` | — | Sender shown to the recipient. 'onboarding@resend.dev' works without domain verification and is fine for a trial; a real deployment should send from its own verified domain. |
| `SMTP_SERVER` | `smtp.gmail.com` | — | SMTP host for the fallback transport. |
| `SMTP_PORT` | `587` | — | SMTP port. 587 is STARTTLS, which is what the client uses. |
| `SMTP_USER` | — | — | SMTP username; also the From address on the SMTP path. |
| `SMTP_PASS` | — | secreta | SMTP password. For Gmail this is an app password, not the account password. |

Desde el panel se pueden escribir: `RESEND_API_KEY`, `EMAIL_FROM`, `SMTP_SERVER`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASS`.

## `whatsapp` — WhatsApp via Twilio — daily alerts, supplier messages and the bot.

*Tipo:* servicio externo. *Editable desde el panel:* sí. *Por tenant:* sí. *Prueba de conexión:* sí.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** No WhatsApp message is sent or received: the daily inventory alert loses its WhatsApp channel (email still goes if configured), purchase orders cannot be sent to a supplier over WhatsApp, and the conversational bot never replies because the webhook has nothing to answer with.

**Mínimo para que encienda:** `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM`

`WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL` is the one that looks optional and is not, once the bot is in use. Twilio signs the inbound webhook over the PUBLIC url; behind a proxy the backend sees an internal one, the signature never matches, and every inbound message is rejected with 403. Empty falls back to X-Forwarded-* headers, then to request.url.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` | — | requerida, secreta | Twilio account SID. Shared with the SMS channel. |
| `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` | — | requerida, secreta | Twilio auth token. Also the key Twilio signs inbound webhooks with, so an outdated value rejects incoming messages as well as failing to send. |
| `TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM` | — | requerida | Sender, WITH the 'whatsapp:' prefix. Twilio's sandbox number works for testing and only reaches people who joined the sandbox. |
| `WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL` | — | — | Public scheme+host Twilio POSTs to, used to rebuild the signed url behind a proxy. Set it whenever the bot runs behind TLS termination or the frontend proxy. |
| `WHATSAPP_BOT_GENERIC_MODE` | `false` | — | When true the bot skips the LLM and replies with a fast, honest generic message. Confirmations still execute deterministically. A stopgap for when no LLM is funded. |

Desde el panel se pueden escribir: `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM`, `WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL`, `WHATSAPP_BOT_GENERIC_MODE`.

Un tenant NO puede tomar: `WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL` — se leen antes de saber de qué tenant viene el mensaje, así que un valor por tenant no lo leería nadie.

## `sms` — SMS via Twilio — heads-up for team messages.

*Tipo:* servicio externo. *Editable desde el panel:* sí. *Por tenant:* sí. *Prueba de conexión:* sí.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** Team-message heads-ups are not texted. The message itself is still delivered in the app; only the SMS nudge is lost.

**Mínimo para que encienda:** `TWILIO_SMS_FROM`, `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`

Shares the Twilio credentials with the WhatsApp service and adds one field: the sender. A 'whatsapp:'-prefixed number CANNOT send SMS, which is why this is a separate variable and not a reuse.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TWILIO_SMS_FROM` | — | requerida | Plain E.164 sender for SMS, without the 'whatsapp:' prefix. |

Además usa, sin duplicarlas: `twilio_account_sid`, `twilio_auth_token`.

Desde el panel se pueden escribir: `TWILIO_SMS_FROM`.

## `rag` — Document search — Voyage AI embeddings over a Pinecone index.

*Tipo:* servicio externo. *Editable desde el panel:* sí. *Por tenant:* no. *Prueba de conexión:* sí.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** Uploaded documents stop being indexed and the analyst can no longer cite them. The assistant still answers from the tenant's own data; it just has no documents to quote.

**Mínimo para que encienda:** `VOYAGEAI_API_KEY`, `PINECONE_API_KEY`, `PINECONE_INDEX`

Needs the `voyageai` and `pinecone` packages installed as well as the keys — a missing package disables the service the same way a missing key does, and says which. The index must be 1024 dimensions, cosine metric, to match the embedding model.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VOYAGEAI_API_KEY` | — | requerida, secreta | Voyage AI key, used to embed both documents and queries. |
| `PINECONE_API_KEY` | — | requerida, secreta | Pinecone API key for the vector store. |
| `PINECONE_INDEX` | — | requerida | Index name. Must be 1024 dims, cosine, serverless. |
| `PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT` | — | — | Pinecone region. Informational for serverless indexes. |

Desde el panel se pueden escribir: `VOYAGEAI_API_KEY`, `PINECONE_API_KEY`, `PINECONE_INDEX`, `PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT`.

## `integrations` — Accounting integrations — Alegra and Siigo.

*Tipo:* servicio externo. *Editable desde el panel:* sí. *Por tenant:* no. *Prueba de conexión:* sí.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** No accounting connection can be created or synced: the credentials cannot be stored, because storing them unencrypted is not an option the code offers.

**Mínimo para que encienda:** `INTEGRATIONS_SECRET_KEY`

`INTEGRATIONS_SECRET_KEY` is a Fernet key and is environment-only on purpose. It encrypts every stored credential — including the ones this very panel writes — so a panel that could rewrite it would make its own stored secrets unreadable with one click. Generate it with:

    python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"

Losing it means every stored credential must be re-entered. It belongs in your secret manager, not in a backup of the database it protects.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INTEGRATIONS_SECRET_KEY` | — | requerida, secreta, solo entorno | Fernet key encrypting every credential stored in the database — accounting connections and everything written from the configuration panel. Environment only. |
| `ALEGRA_BASE_URL` | `https://api.alegra.com/api/v1` | — | Alegra API base. Override only to point at a sandbox. |
| `SIIGO_BASE_URL` | `https://api.siigo.com/v1` | — | Siigo API base. Override only to point at a sandbox. |

Desde el panel se pueden escribir: `ALEGRA_BASE_URL`, `SIIGO_BASE_URL`.

## `contact` — How a customer reaches you to lift the free tier's ceilings.

*Tipo:* servicio externo. *Editable desde el panel:* sí. *Por tenant:* no. *Prueba de conexión:* no.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** The 'write to us' buttons disappear. A free tenant that hits a ceiling then has no way to ask for more room — which is the entire commercial surface of the product, since there is no checkout.

**Basta con una de estas:** `CONTACT_WHATSAPP` **o bien** `CONTACT_EMAIL`

Empty channels are HIDDEN rather than shown broken: a button opening an empty wa.me link is worse than no button. Configure at least one.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CONTACT_WHATSAPP` | — | — | E.164 without the '+', the way wa.me wants it. |
| `CONTACT_EMAIL` | — | — | Address the 'write to us' button opens. |
| `UPGRADE_NOTIFY_EMAIL` | — | — | Where in-app upgrade requests are emailed. Falls back to CONTACT_EMAIL when empty. The request is also stored in `upgrade_requests`, so a failed email never loses the ask. |

Desde el panel se pueden escribir: `CONTACT_WHATSAPP`, `CONTACT_EMAIL`, `UPGRADE_NOTIFY_EMAIL`.

## `worker` — Background training worker and the scheduled-job loops.

*Tipo:* despliegue. *Editable desde el panel:* no. *Por tenant:* no. *Prueba de conexión:* no.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** With the worker off, training sessions queue forever: they are accepted and never run. With the scheduler off, the 8:00 UTC inventory alert, the scheduled recalculations, the integration sync and the monthly snapshot never fire.

Both default to true so a bare `uvicorn backend.main:app` behaves like the single-process dev setup. In a split deployment the API container sets both false and one dedicated worker container runs the loops.

SCHEDULER_ENABLED must be true in EXACTLY ONE instance. Two schedulers send every daily alert twice, and the second one is indistinguishable from a bug in the alert.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WORKER_ENABLED` | `true` | solo entorno | Runs the job-claim/training loop in this process. |
| `SCHEDULER_ENABLED` | `true` | solo entorno | Runs the cron loops: scheduled jobs, daily alerts, integration sync, monthly snapshot. Exactly one instance may have this on. |
| `WORKER_ID` | — | solo entorno | Identity used to claim jobs and to recover this instance's orphaned RUNNING jobs after a crash. Empty falls back to the host name — give a long-lived worker a FIXED id so its orphans are still recognised after the container is recreated. |
| `MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS` | `2` | solo entorno | Training jobs this worker runs at once. |
| `WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `2.0` | solo entorno | Seconds between polls of the jobs table. |

## `limits` — Size ceilings that protect memory and the database.

*Tipo:* despliegue. *Editable desde el panel:* no. *Por tenant:* no. *Prueba de conexión:* no.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** Nothing turns off. These are refusals, not features: exceeding one is always a stated rejection, never a silent truncation.

These are infrastructure ceilings and are NOT the commercial tier limits. Per-tenant allowances live in `backend/entitlements/plans.py`.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB` | `200` | solo entorno | Hard ceiling on an uploaded file, above the tier's own limit. |
| `DATASET_EDITOR_MAX_ROWS` | `50000` | solo entorno | Rows the in-app dataset editor will open. Checked from stored row_count BEFORE reading the file, so a huge file is never loaded into memory to find out it is too big. |
| `DATASET_EDITOR_MAX_MB` | `10` | solo entorno | Same guard, by file size. |
| `SQL_MATERIALIZE_MAX_ROWS` | `500000` | solo entorno | Row ceiling when snapshotting a SQL data source into a CSV dataset. Exceeding it is a refusal, never a truncation. |

## `api_surface` — Public-API-only mode.

*Tipo:* despliegue. *Editable desde el panel:* no. *Por tenant:* no. *Prueba de conexión:* no.

**Qué se pierde sin esto:** With it on, this instance serves ONLY the endpoints a customer's own system is invited to call, plus /health. The web app served from this host stops working entirely — which is the point: it is meant to run as a second instance of the same image.

What it does NOT buy: isolation from the database. Both instances still share one Postgres, so a database problem takes down the customer's integration and the app together.

| Variable | Default | Notas | Qué hace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PUBLIC_API_ONLY` | `false` | solo entorno | Serve only the public integration surface on this instance. |
